name: @avatark/renderer-contracts
description: Renderer-neutral experience-description and renderer-boundary contracts (ExperienceDescription, LocationExperience, RendererAdapter, capability negotiation) -- no React, no CSS, no Unreal, no runtime execution logic. Depends only on @avatark/runtime-contracts for shared id types.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
